notes.title: Reveal cheats.
notes.content:
I'll let you know the cheats ^^
However, please note that excessive use of cheats may halve the fun of the game.


You can enter the cheat key in Settings -> Input window,
Please note that the input window is automatically opened after 2 hours of play time.


[b]
[Cheat Key]
- allpass : unlock all content
- showmethemoney amount: Gold equal to the amount paid
  (ex: showmethemoney 10000)
[/b]


We will update the version containing all nude cheats within this week.
thank you.
